caveats: ABI4/5/6/8/9 reuse alignment-pair storage at first launch; alignment CCR4 pairing is retained, but its paired raw records are replaced.

alignment_hook_max_us includes selected alignment/pair work; stored with a65535-cycle ceiling. Neither maximum is a whole-ISR measurement.
ABI10: first attempt only. Every consumed triplet for first 2 ms, then one in eight plus all ACCEPT samples, up to 80 ms or 512 records.
Software ADC-readout timestamps and current timer register snapshots, not hardware sample times or an oscilloscope waveform.

Hook maximum covers selected recorder work only; excludes eligibility, detector, IRQ and launch header reset. No guarantee of unchanged timing.
Latest throttle episode;6 attempts total including the first. Accepted events are ADC-qualified feedback, not measured rotor angle/direction.
Times are software DWT observations, not oscilloscope timestamps. Successful startup timing freezes at handoff; stop_reason may describe a later operator stop/runtime loss.
